fields.name: Days Between Popups
fields.description: Once the user has seen the popover, they will not be shown it again for this number of days, on the current device. Setting this to 0 will result in it always showing, as no cookie will be set. Default: 90 days

fields.name: Popup Minimum Delay (Seconds)
fields.description: Minimum time the user has to be on the page before they can be shown the Data Capture Popup/Form. Default: 1 second

fields.name: Popup Fixed Delay (Seconds)
fields.description: Display the popover after this number of seconds, even if there has been no intent to exit. Set to 0 if you don't wish to have a fixed delay.

fields.name: Show On Exit Intent
fields.description: Show the Data Capture when the user shows an intent to leave the page by moving their mouse towards the close page button. Default: True

fields.name: Delay Before Exit Intent (ms)
fields.description: How long after an exit intent signal to wait before displaying the Data Capture Popup/Form. Increasing this value can help avoid false positives. Requires the 'Show on Exit Intent' checkbox to be ticked. Default: 250 milliseconds

fields.name: Show On Load
fields.description: Always display the Data Capture, even if the user has recently seen it. Useful for testing. Default: False

fields.name: Cookie Name
fields.description: Set the cookie name to be set when the user sees the SmartBlock, to prevent it appearing again within the time period set. Popover SmartBlocks that share a cookie name will all be hidden for the period, when one is dismissed. Ensure this name is different to display multiple popover SmartBlocks on the same site, simultaneously. These cookies are first party cookies, whose settings can be found here.
